Name: Sea Breeze Farm Map - Island Farm
Author: collingbe
Description:
[size=3][color=#f4f4f4]Replaces the beach/island farm map[/color]


[color=#ffff00]1.0.6 Update   更新:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4]updated for 1.6. Added sunset view ﻿为1.6更新完毕。添加日落景色 ﻿1.6 업데이트. 일몰 뷰 추가 했어용. [/color]
[/list]

[color=#ffff00]1.0.4 Update   更新:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]fixed meteorite and other spawnables can spawn on sky      天空不会再出现陨石之类的物品[/size][/color]
[/list]
[color=#ffff00]1.0.3 Update   更新:[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]now the sky changes to night at 7:30 pm in game.      天空在游戏内晚上七点半会变成星空[/size]
[*][size=3]the lounge area on the beach is removed for fall and winter ﻿秋天和冬天海滩上不再有躺椅和伞[/size]
[*][size=3]fixed bug that the player can walk though the waterfall beside the cave entrance ﻿修复可以走进洞穴入口两侧瀑布的bug[/size]
[*][size=3]now includes optional version which removes the window beside the spouse area ﻿可选无飘窗版本[/size]
[/list]
[img]http://i.pinimg.com/564x/95/89/98/958998f257f2996b4fd9ed64b3833a32.jpg[/img]


[b]Please read!![/b]
[list]
[*][s]The sky will not change into the night sky like north ginger island, which will make the sky look a bit awkward during night time. I have no idea how to change this, so if this bothers you please consider before using this mod. And if you happen to know how to fix this problem, please tell me!! (please please please)[/s]
[*]Some areas of the map are intentionally not decorated, so you can decorate however you want to. Furnitures can be placed on the floored tiles above the spouse area and the picnic blanket.
[*]You can sleep in the tent beside the pool, this might be handy for late night fishing XD.
[*]Sprinklers can be placed on the sand.
[/list]

The map recolor is made by me :D

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you've encountered a bug, or have any suggestions!

[b][size=3]Credits:[/size]
[/b]The furnitures used on the floored tiles are [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url][b]'s[/b] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444?tab=description]Industrial Furniture Set[/url]﻿ .﻿﻿



[b]必读！！[/b]
[list]
[*][s]入夜后天空不会变成星空。我也不知道怎么解决这个问题……所以如果介意的话，请慎重考虑要不要用。如果有人知道怎么解决这个问题求求你告诉我呜呜呜呜[/s]
[*]为了更方便大家随心所欲的装饰，有些地方被特意留空了。配偶区域上面的飘窗和野餐毯上都可以放家具
[*]泳池旁边的帐篷可以过夜
[*]沙滩上可以放洒水器
[/list]

地图改色是我的蓝草嘿嘿嘿

如果在使用该mod时遇到了任何问题，或者有任何建议，欢迎随时戳我！
严禁二传和盗卖，如果被我发现淘宝或咸鱼之类的有人盗卖我的mod，我很可能会直接停止分发我的mod。：）

[b][size=3]使用素材：[/size][/b]
飘窗上的家具来源于[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url][b]的[/b] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444?tab=description]Industrial Furniture Set[/url]﻿ 。



[b][size=3]아래 글 참조 부탁드려요![/size][/b]
[list]
[*]모드 이용자의 입맛에 맞는 꾸미기를 위해, 맵 일부 구역은 의도적으로 데코되어있지 않습니다.
[*]가구들은 배우자 구역과 소풍 담요 위 바닥 타일에 배치할  수 있습니다. 
[*]수영장 옆에 배치되어있는 텐트에서 잘 수 있어요, 아마 밤낚시에 유용할지도? 
[*]스프링클러는 모래 위에 설치할 수 있습니다. 
[/list]

버그를 발견하셨거나 궁금한 점이 있으시다면 주저말고 연락 주세요!
